text.en: This Order may cited as the Customs (Amendment) Order, 2008 and shall on 1st. November, 2008. of section 140 of S 39/06.

Section 14011) of the Customs Order, 2006, in this Order referred to as the is amended - {a} in sub-paragraph {iii) -

(i) by inserting "subject to sub-paragraph (iv)," immediately before "in" in the first line;

(ii) in the proviso, by deleting the fullstop and by substituting a semicolon therefor; {b} by adding the following new sub-paragraph - "(iv) in the case of prohibited goods as specified in the Schedule - !A) for the first offence, to a fine of not less than $10,000 and not $500,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years or both; and

(B) for a second or subsequent offence, to a fine of not less than and not exceeding $500,000, imprisonment for a than 6 months and not exceeding 5 years or both.". of new section 151A.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 151 - of Schedule. 151A. The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by order published in the Gazette, amend the Schedule.". of new Schedule.
The principal Order is amended by adding the following new Schedule - 1) (iv))

Kerosene.". Made this lOth. day of Syawal, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 11th. day of October, 2008 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
